spans.s: हिरण n. 1. Semen; 2. gold; 3. a cowrie.
हिरण्मय (I) a. (f. यी) Made of gold, golden, हिरण्मयं हंसमबोधि नैषधः Na.i.117.
हिरण्मय (II) m. Brahman (m.).
हिरण्मय (I) a. (f. यी) Made of gold, golden, हिरण्मयं हंसमबोधि नैषधः Na.i.117.
हिरण्य n. 1. Gold, M.ii.29, 246; 2. silver; 6. any precious metal; 4. wealth, property; 5. semen virile; 6. a cowrie; 7. a particular measure; 8. the Dhattūra plant; 9. a substance.
हिरण्य-कक्ष a. wearing a golden girdle.
हिरण्य-कोश m. gold and silver wrought or unwrought.
हिरण्य-गर्भ m. 1. a name of Brahman (m.); 2. a name of Viṣṇu; 3. the soul invested by the subtle body (सूक्ष्मशरीर).
हिरण्य-द (I) a. giving or granting gold, M.iv.230.
हिरण्य-द (II) m. the ocean.
हिरण्य-दा f. the earth.
हिरण्य-नाभ m. the mountain Maināka.
हिरण्य-बाह, -बाहु m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. the river Śoṇā.
हिरण्य-बाह, -बाहु m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. the river Śoṇā.
हिरण्य-रेतस् m. 1. fire; 2. the sun; 3. an epithet of Śiva; 4. the Arka plant.
हिरण्य-वाह m. the river Śoṇā.
हिरण्यय a. (f. यी) Golden.
हिरण्यय a. (f. यी) Golden.
हिरुक् m. 1. Without, except; 2. in the midst of; 3. near.
हीर (I) m. 1. A snake; 2. a necklace; 3. a lion; 4. an epithet of Śiva; 5. name of the father of Harsha, the author of the Naishadhīya.
हीर (II) n. 1. Indra’s thunderbolt; 2. a diamond.
हीरा f. An epithet of Lakṣmī.
हीर-अंग m. Indra’s thunderbolt.
हीरक m. A diamond.
